description: List bookings. Filter by q (text), status (all|confirmed|quotes), upcoming=true (next gig today or later) or past=true (last gig date before today), and/or a gig-date range from/to (YYYY-MM-DD; keeps bookings whose gig dates overlap it). Filters combine. Each row has first_date and last_date (its gig span).

from.description: The sender — an email address or phone number, per the tool.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (integer; default varies, cap ~100).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (0-based integer).

q.description: Search text; with multiple words, all must match.

status.description: A status value — see the tool's description for the allowed set.

to.description: The recipient — an email address or phone number, per the tool.

name: list_bookings
title: List Bookings
